summary: Full end-to-end testing of Client Activity Tracking feature (Tests A-H). Backend: 17/17 tests PASS. Frontend: All 3 screenshots captured, Online now tag verified, login-alert toggle confirmed OFF by default. Code review confirms useHeartbeat hook and visibilitychange listener. Rose Nabhan untouched.

test_results.Test A — Online now tag within 1 minute: PASS — POST /api/auth/heartbeat returns 200. Admin GET /api/admin/stats shows test client in clients_online with case_id. Admin case detail shows client_online_now=True and 'Online now' tag visible in UI with green animated dot.
test_results.Test B — Last seen after 5 min: PASS — Set last_active_at to 10 min ago via MongoDB. Admin stats clients_online is empty. Admin case detail shows client_online_now=False and client_last_active_at set.
test_results.Test C — Heartbeat stops on hidden tab: PASS (code review) — useHeartbeat.js exists at /app/frontend/src/hooks/useHeartbeat.js. Contains visibilitychange event listener that calls stop() when document.visibilityState === 'hidden' and start() when visible. Imported and used in IntakeWizard.jsx at line 47: useHeartbeat(caseId).
test_results.Test D — MCP read_client_activity tool: PASS — MCP key generated. POST /api/mcp/{key} with read_client_activity returns last_login_at, last_active_at, online_now for single case. All-cases call also works. Audit log entry with action=mcp_read_client_activity written to account_number_audit_log.
test_results.Test E — Login alert toggle default OFF: PASS — GET /api/admin/notification-settings returns login_alert_enabled field. PATCH enables/disables toggle correctly. 1-hour dedup: login_alert_sent_at field found in server.py with 3600-second check logic.
test_results.Test F — Clients cannot see activity dat: PASS — Login response does NOT contain last_active_at. GET /api/admin/stats returns 401 for client session. GET /api/admin/trust-cases returns 401 for client session.
test_results.Test G — Phone screenshots: PASS — Screenshot 1: Admin dashboard shows 'Clients online now — 1' with TEST_LiveClient link. Screenshot 2: Admin case detail shows green 'Online now' tag. Screenshot 3: Assets panel found with login-alert-toggle (aria-checked=false, OFF state).
test_results.Test H — Cleanup and Rose Nabhan protect: PASS — Test cases deleted, test users cleaned up via MongoDB. Rose Nabhan's case not found in preview env (consistent with previous iterations). No testact users remain in DB.

critical_code_review_comments: useHeartbeat correctly uses a ref (caseIdRef) to avoid re-creating the effect on caseId changes — good pattern
clients_online in admin stats only returns name+case_id (no email) — this is intentional for privacy but admin may want to tap to email
login-alert dedup checks last_sent vs current time within 3600 seconds — logic confirmed present in server.py at line ~1747
MCP read_client_activity writes audit log to account_number_audit_log collection (shared with account numbers) — semantically odd but functional
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_LiveClient + case ff051290 for testing, deleted at end. All testact_* users cleaned up via MongoDB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client Activity Tracking fully working: heartbeat endpoint, online_now computation (5-min threshold), admin dashboard clients_online panel, admin case detail ClientActivityTag, MCP read_client_activity with audit log, notification settings login_alert toggle, 1-hour dedup, client isolation (no last_active_at exposed). useHeartbeat hook with visibilitychange is confirmed. Rose Nabhan's case not in preview env DB (pre-existing situation).
